searchText: We should probably start changing any of the deposit tools to use execution addresses for withdrawals by default, and stop generating deposits with 0x00 creds for withdrawals... We had discussed this during devcon but its worth thinking about here again. Tools can change whenever... ethstaker-deposit-cli already does this in its current pre-release v1.3.1. We intend to cut a v1.4.0 release after mainnet Glamsterdam date has been announced. Mostly because the timing seems good. That also allows us to drop Platåberget support in the same release, and gives people time to test the pre-release including the builder deposit functionality on Hoodi For this tool, our biggest lift will be generating PQ keys. Once the CL teams know what the signature scheme will be. Reading ethlabs’ post, the proposed pqai27 timeline (which ACD have *not* committed to, understood, that’s the big discussion point in coming ACD calls): - PQ pubkey registry whenever, no hard fork needed. Tooling needs to be ready ofc - Bogotá on EL with Frames and … SPHINCS but not leanSPHINCS. Users can make PQ tx but it’ll cost until leanSPHINCS is in. Accurate? - Heze on CL, later, decoupled from Bogotá, with PQ consensus. Whichever form that takes, whether Gasper or Decoupled Consensus, whether with or without easy DVT support I\* then makes PQ tx cheaper, adds PQ to DA layer (blobs), generally tidies up around PQ. Stretch goal is to have PQ enabled FOCIL also in I\*
